capabilities: Two-way sync events with CalDAV/iCloud servers without overwriting local edits
Store events as Markdown blocks in monthly vault notes with space for personal notes
Display events in list, day, week, month and stats dashboard views
Create events via natural language commands or a form with categories, recurrence and reminders
Drag event cards on day/week time grids to move, resize or reschedule them
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; not yet listed in the community plugin directory (installable via BRAT or manual download); supports read-only ICS URL import; bilingual Chinese/English interface; includes a detailed security-and-permissions section and troubleshooting FAQ.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calendar agenda panel and no way to sync events with a CalDAV server or iCloud while keeping them as vault notes.
summary: Calendar plugin that two-way syncs CalDAV/iCloud events into local Markdown monthly notes and displays them in list, day, week, month and stats views.
